title: Single-coordinate chains between flat quasi-finite affine-space charts
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, $d\geq0$, and $X$ a separated finite-type $k$-scheme pure of dimension $d$ [def-weil-pure-dimension] [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Suppose $X$ is Cohen–Macaulay, meaning that every local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ has depth equal to its Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-depth], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Let $u,v:X\to\mathbf A^d_k$ be quasi-finite flat morphisms [def-sbc-affine-space], [pqf-def-quasifinite], [def-weil-flat-morphism]. For every closed point $x\in X$ there are an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$, an integer $r\geq0$, and quasi-finite flat morphisms $w_0,\ldots,w_r:U\to\mathbf A^d_k$ with $w_0=u|_U$, $w_r=v|_U$, such that each consecutive pair has all but at most one of its $d$ coordinate functions equal. For $d=0$ one may take $r=0$.
